Author: OhGodAGirl
Name: Spring Cleaning
Description: Your very own spring-cleaning fairy, kupo! Spring Cleaning keeps your glamour collection tidy: sweep eligible gear from your Inventory and Armoury Chest into the Glamour Dresser or Armoire; move anything that belongs in the Armoire out of your Dresser; and find and clear unwanted duplicates—all with configurable protections for the things you want to keep.
